list: Official trophy list as published on PlayStation, as collected by PSNProfiles and Exophase and cross-checked against KeenGamer, GTA Spotter and GamesFuze (November 2026). Names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written for this entry in its own words.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned — there is no separate task. Finish the story, the 100% checklist, the eight Stranger strands and every activity and crime trophy, and it unlocks last. Plan for roughly 200 hours across a single playthrough; nothing here needs a second run.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the final story mission; it pops with the credits. It is the only gold story trophy. The platinum hunt continues in free roam afterwards, so nothing is lost by finishing the story first.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
sources: GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion through the in-game checklist under Progress, then Stats, after the story. The checklist asks for selected portions, not everything: 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos, 42 shooting-range golds, 42 drone trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 Bret target decks, 200 vehicles scanned and 100 animals studied. Work through it after the story; progress made during the story already counts. It is the longest grind, roughly 100 hours of cleanup.
trophies.name: A Long Road
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: jumps, under-bridge flights, Knife Flights and base jumps. Stunts count from the start, so attempt jumps and flights whenever you travel instead of leaving them all for cleanup. The 100% checklist needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges. Learn each range's scoring, pick the best weapon for the drill, and replay a challenge until gold — there is no limit on attempts. The 100% checklist also needs all 42 golds, so this is not optional for the platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear all over the map; eight full strands are needed, and the five character strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone — count toward it. Mop up the remaining strands in free roam after the story; every quest giver tied to a trophy comes back.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap
GTA Spotter — GTA VI trophies and achievements: the full official list

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; three full sets are enough for the trophy, while the 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting after it pops.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations: landmarks, curiosities and sculptures. Open the WAiNK app and scan anything unfamiliar as you travel — vehicles and locations both count toward other goals, so scanning early saves hours later. 100 scans is also a line on the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults unlock during Chapter 4, when the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… opens them. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so plan on robbing more than five.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The first meditation is the only missable interaction in the game: after the mission Down to Earth, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning and accept her invitation to meditate on the balcony — do it before leaving Chapter 1. The last spot only opens once you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist needs 15 of 18, but the trophy needs all 18. Make a manual save before Chapter 1 ends as insurance.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand marks unique animals; track one down and take it. Bret's 15 target decks are also part of the 100% checklist, so keep hunting after this pops.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt. None needs to be won or finished — one attempt at each is enough, so sample them as they unlock.
